objectives: Falsify reliability of a frozen factorized transition/reward prequential detector on truly new exogenous synthetic draws without altering the accepted native learner.
Separate sensitivity, false alarm rate, and source evidence parity. Do not infer policy improvement because factorized monitors are shadow signals only, not deployed hypothesis resets.
Classify every true boundary independently; duplicate alarms count against specificity.
acquisition: Each of 9 streams starts from the original byte-exact CKAD22 448-witness parent checkpoint and uses the unchanged CKAD23 native stream's first and second public intervention choices; separate monitors receive identical chosen actions, public S2 and Y after their consequences occur.

detectors.joint: CKAD23 original native stream threshold: S_joint=max(1,S_joint/(4*p_T_observed*p_Y_observed)), alarm S_joint>=16 and >=8 episodes since last reset. Monitor must exactly match original independent CKAD23 reference.
detectors.transition: S_T=max(1,S_T/(2*p_T_observed)), alarm S_T>=16 and >=8 since last reset; reset S_T to 1.
detectors.reward: S_Y=max(1,S_Y/(2*p_Y_observed)), alarm S_Y>=16 and >=8 since last reset; reset S_Y to 1.
detectors.factorized_or: Maintain independent transition/reward S_T,S_Y with same factors 2 and threshold16. At first alarm on either component with 8 episodes since last OR alarm, record source witness, reset both S_T,S_Y to1.
detectors.stationary: The null schedule has no true change points; all alarms under every mechanism are false alarms.

controls: native joint-surprise alarm with exact rational replay parity
same-actions same-outcomes and 448-prefix immutable witness custody
cold checkpoint equality and cross-OS semantic and bytes replication

frozen_gates.sensitivity: For BOTH actual-change schedules, factorized OR detects EACH of three change points within +1..+16 public episodes in at least 2 of 3 independent parent groups.
frozen_gates.comparative_sensitivity: Factorized OR has at least 4 more total distinct true-boundary detections than the joint native stream across both change schedules (18 opportunities).
frozen_gates.specificity: At most three duplicate/unmatched factorized alarms per seed in each changed schedule, and at most one alarm per seed in no-change stationary null.
frozen_gates.evidence: All nine exact 640-episode history prefixes and unique witness ids preserved, cross-platform exact rational replay and checkpoint identity, no scientific promotion.

classification: DEVELOPMENT_SIGNAL_GO only if every frozen gate passes, otherwise DEVELOPMENT_SIGNAL_NO_GO; any source/test failure is ENGINEERING_FAIL/UNVERIFIED rather than scientific failure.
limits: Factorized alarms are shadow signals calculated from the frozen native model's public forecasts. They do not change the native hypothesis posterior/weights or the source's active policy. This tests detection information, NOT whether split alarms improve policy reward or retention.
scope: Read-only advisory Mind-Palace plus isolated GitHub contributor branch; no merge, owner PR edits, accepted-main, source controller, scheduler, real-world action or promotion
